scope: stage_4 CPU viewer post-model alert filtering

bug.summary: model_v1 viewer split bypassed temporal confirmation, so one-frame backend model candidates showed a warning banner.
bug.root_cause: backendModelSplit returned backend reportable indices directly before the shared temporal confirmation logic could run.

fix.summary: Build connected components from backend model reportable indices and apply the same neighbor-frame confirmation policy before UI warning/reportable output.
preserved_contracts: UNKNOWN is not treated as CLEAR
model_v1 reportable indices are not replaced by legacy JS min-point thresholds

validation_level: targeted viewer regression and adjacent CPU viewer tests only
residual_risk: At the time of this viewer-only fix, ROS2 C++ publish layer was still frame-local; the later stage_5_ros2_temporal_runtime.md change adds causal temporal confirmation to public ROS2 intrusion_candidate_present.
Full doubleT_obstacle replay was not rerun in this turn.
This does not create model_v2 or synthetic-data training support.
